title: Prolactin

review.note: Drafted from the source below; not yet reviewed by a medical professional.

measures: This test measures the level of prolactin, a hormone made by the pituitary gland at the base of the brain. Its main role is to signal breast tissue to grow during pregnancy and make milk after birth.
context: Prolactin is normally high during pregnancy and while breastfeeding, and low at other times. Levels also change through the day, so blood is usually drawn a few hours after waking. Stress, exercise, a high-protein diet, and certain medicines can raise it.
aboveRange: A higher level may be associated with a benign (non-cancer) pituitary growth called a prolactinoma, or another pituitary condition
It may also be linked to an underactive thyroid, kidney conditions, PCOS, certain medicines, or everyday causes such as stress or exercise
belowRange: A lower level is uncommon but may be associated with a pituitary condition
nextStep: Discuss this result with your doctor.
